fusions.name: Sign of Halting
fusions.desc: You trace a sign of halting with two fingers, dealing 12 arcane damage to everything in a cone 4 tiles long and stunning each for 1 second.

fusions.name: Benediction Strike
fusions.desc: Presses a blessing written on your palm onto one enemy up to 5 tiles away, dealing 30 radiant damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach. When it hits, your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Fluent Fingers
fusions.desc: Increases your casting speed by 30% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Rehearsed Gesture
fusions.desc: When you spend mana, your critical hit chance rises by 10% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
